claims.quote: These findings establish pathogenicity of the Phe240Leu KCNT2 mutation in the reported EOEE patient.
The de novo heterozygous variant Phe240Leu SLICK was identified by exome sequencing and confirmed by Sanger sequencing.
First, [Cl-]i sensitivity was reversed in Phe240Leu channels.

claims.object_text: altered ion selectivity favoring Na+ over K+
claims.quote: Second, predominantly K+-selective WT channels were made to favor Na+ over K+ by Phe240Leu.
Third, and consequent to altered ion selectivity, Phe240Leu channels had larger inward conductance.

claims.object_text: primary neuron expression causing membrane hyperexcitability
claims.quote: Further, rSlick channels induced membrane hyperexcitability when expressed in primary neurons, resembling the cellular seizure phenotype.
